> 
> Acts as a deterrent to fraud **(1) **as it will be prepared by a different member of staff to the ledger clerk** (1)**.

> Maintaining a trade receivables ledger control account results in many benefits to the business **(1)**.
> 
> **Accept any other appropriate responses.**
